partners.mechanism_chain: CLCN5 (HGNC:2355) —DISRUPTS→ Renal tubule transport (GO:0015723); Renal tubule transport (GO:0015723) —LEADS_TO→ Nephrolithiasis (HP:0000063); Renal tubule transport (GO:0015723) —LEADS_TO→ Renal failure (HP:0000083); SCNN1A (HGNC:10610) —DISRUPTS→ Renal tubule transport (GO:0015723); Renal tubule transport (GO:0015723) —LEADS_TO→ Hypertension (HP:0000827); Renal tubule transport (GO:0015723) —LEADS_TO→ Hypokalemia (HP:0002170). Both CLCN5 and SCNN1A are critical for normal renal tubule transport. Dysfunctional CLCN5 leads to altered ion and water reabsorption, contributing to nephrolithiasis and renal failure. The convergence is on the shared pathway of renal tubule transport, where defects in either gene disrupt the overall homeostasis maintained by the tubules.
